projects.title: Simple.Interpreter
projects.description: A lightweight C# library providing a straightforward interpreter for a simple, custom expression language. This NuGet package enables developers to empower their customers or clients to define dynamic expressions for various purposes, such as business rules, conditional logic, and data filtering, without requiring code recompilation.

blog.title: We Were Waiting for Green. Green Was Never Coming.
blog.tagline: We lost days to a container that was failing exactly as intended. Nobody had written down what working looked like.
blog.lesson: write things down while they're still confusing, before they look obvious

blog.title: Slower Is a Tool. Blocked Is a Dependency.
blog.tagline: A friend ran out of AI credits and development stopped. The live site carried on serving customers. The only thing that had failed was the ability to change it.
blog.lesson: if something you're using disappeared, would you be slower or would you be blocked?

blog.title: The Question My Plugin Loader Couldn't Answer
blog.tagline: A plugin loader that would happily load anything implementing the right interface, until someone asked what was actually stopping it from loading the wrong tenant's plugin.
blog.lesson: don't assume an interface check covers authorisation

blog.title: The Column That Looked Like Nothing
blog.tagline: A TenantId column on every table, filtered on every query, and never once indexed, until scale finally noticed.
blog.lesson: check for proper indexing sooner rather than later

linkedin.title: Leadership Doesn't Start With a Title

linkedin.title: Intent Outlasts Imitation
linkedin.tagline: 'Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of those ahead. Seek what they sought.' Growth isn't copying someone's path — it's chasing the intent behind it.

linkedin.title: Debugging Our Mindset
linkedin.tagline: We spend so much time debugging code — but how often do we debug our mindset? Introducing #DeveloperMindset: short reflections on the human side of the craft.

linkedin.title: How Long Would It Take to Onboard a New Dev?
linkedin.tagline: One simple question exposes a project's real health — code clarity, docs, tests, naming. The faster someone new gets productive, the stronger the project.
